description: Regenerate GO decision table + tPA/DSPA-gamma exosite comparison with QuickGO-verified sources and provenance figure
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

go = pd.DataFrame([
 ["GO:0004252","serine-type endopeptidase activity","MF","IEA InterPro/EC (GO_REF:0000120)","SUPPORTED core - retain"],
 ["GO:0031639","plasminogen activation","BP","IEA TreeGrafter PTN000667065","SUPPORTED core - retain"],
 ["GO:0005576","extracellular region","CC","IEA SubCell","SUPPORTED - retain"],
 ["GO:0048008","PDGF receptor signaling pathway","BP","IEA TreeGrafter PTN000667065","OVER-ANNOTATED - remove/non-core"],
 ["GO:0014909","smooth muscle cell migration","BP","IEA TreeGrafter PTN000667065","OVER-ANNOTATED - remove/non-core"],
 ["GO:0071396","cellular response to lipid","BP","IEA ARBA00027803","WEAK - remove/non-core"],
 ["GO:1901701","cellular response to oxygen-containing compound","BP","IEA ARBA00027483","WEAK - remove/non-core"],
], columns=["GO_ID","Term","Aspect","Source (verified via QuickGO)","Assessment"])
go.to_csv("/tmp/K9IJK6_GO_decision_table.csv", index=False)

# Domain / exosite comparison with functional annotation
arch = pd.DataFrame([
 ["Human tPA (PLAT/P00750)","F-E-K1-K2-P","39-81 (annexinA2 42-52)","82-120 (LRP1 res102)","127-208 & 215-296","357/406/513","562"],
 ["DSPA-gamma / K9IJK6","K-P","ABSENT","ABSENT","44-126 (single)","189/238/345","394"],
], columns=["Protein","Architecture","Finger(exosite)","EGF(exosite)","Kringle(s)","Catalytic triad","Length"])
arch.to_csv("/tmp/K9IJK6_exosite_comparison.csv", index=False)

print(go.to_string(index=False)); print(); print(arch.to_string(index=False))

fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,6),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1.4,1]})
for ax in axs: ax.axis("off")
# table 1
cols=["#c8e6c9" if a.startswith("SUPPORTED") else "#ffcdd2" if a.startswith("OVER") else "#fff9c4" for a in go["Assessment"]]
t1=axs[0].table(cellText=go.values,colLabels=go.columns,cellLoc="left",loc="center")
t1.auto_set_font_size(False);t1.set_fontsize(8);t1.scale(1,1.5)
for i,c in enumerate(cols): t1[(i+1,4)].set_facecolor(c)
axs[0].set_title("K9IJK6 (DSPA-gamma) GO curation assessment — sources verified via QuickGO; all process terms IEA",fontweight="bold")
# table 2
t2=axs[1].table(cellText=arch.values,colLabels=arch.columns,cellLoc="center",loc="center")
t2.auto_set_font_size(False);t2.set_fontsize(8);t2.scale(1,1.6)
for j in range(len(arch.columns)):
    t2[(2,j)].set_facecolor("#ffe0b2")
axs[1].set_title("tPA vs DSPA-gamma: finger/EGF exosites (annexin A2, LRP1) physically ABSENT in K9IJK6",fontweight="bold")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("/tmp/K9IJK6_curation_provenance.png",dpi=140,bbox_inches="tight"); plt.show()
print("\nartifacts: /tmp/K9IJK6_GO_decision_table.csv, /tmp/K9IJK6_exosite_comparison.csv, /tmp/K9IJK6_curation_provenance.png")
